edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender in the public transfer function.
msg.sender is used as the spender when decreasing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner when approving in approve.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the effective from address via callers.
manualswap authorizes msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to _owner.
setBots is guarded by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender.
block.timestamp gates the buy cooldown check and is written into cooldown.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates the state-changing logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the state-changing logic to _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection obtains the current rate from _getRate.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer for balance updates.
_transfer triggers an external router swap before final balance settlement.
_transfer triggers external ETH transfers to fee wallets mid-transfer.
_tokenTransfer routes to the standard transfer implementation.
_transferStandard computes values via _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies fees via _reflectFee.
_getValues derives token values from _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values from _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_takeTeam uses _getRate to convert the team token share.
_getRate divides supplies obtained from _getCurrentSupply.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
swapTokensForEth makes an external call into the Uniswap router with a user-influenced path.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to external payable wallets.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
openTrading adds liquidity through an external payable router call.
openTrading approves the pair contract externally.
_rOwned balances are read and written in _transferStandard.
_allowances is read and updated during transferFrom.
bots blacklist flags gate whether a transfer is allowed.
cooldown mapping is read and written to enforce buy timing.
uniswapV2Pair address determines fee/swap branches in _transfer.
inSwap guard state is checked before performing the auto swap.
swapEnabled determines whether the automatic swap path executes.
cooldownEnabled determines whether the cooldown check executes.
_maxTxAmount caps the buy amount when cooldown is enforced.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call.
_feeAddr1 is consumed as the tax fee in _getValues.
_feeAddr2 is consumed as the team fee in _getValues.
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee via SafeMath sub.
_tFeeTotal is increased by the token fee via SafeMath add.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half the ETH and gates manualswap/manualsend.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half the ETH payout.
tradingOpen guard prevents openTrading from being called twice.
_owner guards openTrading through the onlyOwner modifier.
from parameter drives source balance checks and blacklist logic.
to parameter drives destination balance checks and swap routing.
amount parameter is compared to the max transaction and cooldown limits.
tokenAmount parameter is the amount approved and swapped for ETH.
amount parameter is halved with SafeMath div before being transferred.
sender parameter is debited in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter is credited in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is decomposed into fee and transfer values.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping.
path local array is built and passed to the router swap.
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the swap input amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer core routine and should be folded into it.
The to parameter only exists to feed the _transfer core routine and should be folded into it.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer core routine and should be folded into it.
The tokenAmount parameter only exists to feed swapTokensForEth and should be folded into it.
The amount parameter only exists to feed sendETHToFee and should be folded into it.
The sender parameter only exists to feed _transferStandard and should be folded into it.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed _transferStandard and should be folded into it.
The tAmount parameter only exists to feed _transferStandard and should be folded into it.
The bots_ array only exists to feed setBots and should be folded into it.
The path local variable is used only inside swapTokensForEth's external swap.
The contractTokenBalance local is used only as the input of the swapTokensForEth call.
